test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: By selling an item for ₹1,729 Rohini made a loss of 30%. At what price should she sell the item to make a gain of 16%?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Loss of **30%** means the **Selling Price** is **70%** of the **Cost Price (CP)**.

⇒ 70% = ₹1,729

To make a **gain** of **16%**, the required **Selling Price** should be **116%** of CP.

⇒ Required SP = (1,729 ÷ 70) × 116

⇒ Required SP = 24.7 × 116 = ₹2,865.20

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,865.20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First **Selling Price (SP₁)** = ₹1,729

**Loss Percentage** = 30%

Desired **Gain Percentage** = 16%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75f7b0c900e6e5ba82ec453206da844a97331773b986a9c1aa9c9588b457b389.png] 

**Step 1: Find the Cost Price (CP)**

⇒ CP = (SP₁ × 100) ÷ (100 − Loss%)

⇒ CP = (1,729 × 100) ÷ (100 − 30)

⇒ CP = (1,729 × 100) ÷ 70

⇒ CP = 24.7 × 100 = **₹2,470**

**Step 2: Find the new Selling Price (SP₂)**

⇒ SP₂ = CP × (100 + Gain%) ÷ 100

⇒ SP₂ = 2,470 × (100 + 16) ÷ 100

⇒ SP₂ = 2,470 × (116 ÷ 100)

⇒ SP₂ = 2,470 × 1.16

⇒ SP₂ = **₹2,865.20**

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,865.20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Profit and Loss Formulas

Profit = SP − CP; Loss = CP − SP. Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100; Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100.

Marked Price (MP) and Discount

Selling Price = Marked Price − Discount. Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100.

Effective Rate for Successive Changes

For two successive changes of a% and b%, the effective change is [a + b + (ab ÷ 100)]%.
